meta.title: Which AWS certification fits you?
meta.subtitle: Answer a few quick questions and get a recommended first certification and a next step.
meta.disclaimer: Exam versions, prices and dates change. Always check the official AWS page before booking.
meta.price_note: Prices are AWS list prices in USD before tax; local prices may differ.

resources.label: Free exam prep on AWS Skill Builder

q_experience.text: How much hands-on experience do you have with AWS or other cloud platforms?

options.label: None yet, I'm new to the cloud
A bit: tutorials, uni or side projects
A lot: I use it regularly at work or in serious projects (about 1+ year)
Tech: computer science, engineering, data or similar
Business, management or another non-technical field

q_business_interest.text: What would you most like to understand better?

options.label: How the cloud works and what AWS offers
What AI can do and how it works
How organizations should invest in, govern and scale AI

q_tech_goal.text: What do you want from your first AWS certification?

options.label: A solid overview of the cloud before going deeper
A foundation in AI and generative AI
I'm ready to study harder and go for a job-relevant cert

q_focus.text: Which kind of work sounds most exciting to you?

options.label: Designing systems: how all the pieces fit together
Writing code and building applications
Keeping systems running: monitoring, automation, troubleshooting
Working with data and data pipelines
AI and machine learning
Security

q_ai.text: What kind of AI work interests you most?

options.label: Training, deploying and monitoring ML models
Building apps on top of LLMs: chatbots, RAG, agents
Not sure yet, I want the big picture first

q_has_associate.text: Do you already hold an Associate-level AWS certification?

options.label: Yes
Not yet

q_focus_pro.text: Where do you want to go deeper?

options.label: Architecture at scale: multi-account, migrations, hybrid
DevOps: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automation
Generative AI in production: Bedrock, RAG, agents
Machine learning and data
Security
Networking: hybrid connectivity, complex VPC designs

r_clf_business.reason: You'll learn the language of the cloud: what the main AWS services do, how pricing works and how security responsibilities are shared. No coding needed, which makes it ideal if you work alongside tech teams.

r_aif_business.reason: It explains AI, machine learning and generative AI in plain terms, with real use cases. Once you know how the technology works, AI Business Strategist adds the strategy and governance side.

r_aib.reason: This one is built for people who decide about AI rather than build it: choosing investments, building the business case and scaling adoption responsibly. AI Practitioner is a good companion if you also want the technical basics.

r_clf_tech.reason: A quick, low-pressure way to get the big picture of AWS. With a tech background you can move on to Solutions Architect – Associate soon after.

r_aif_tech.reason: It gives you the AI, ML and generative AI vocabulary and the AWS services behind it. Machine Learning Engineer – Associate is the natural hands-on next step.

r_saa.reason: The most popular technical AWS certification. You'll learn to combine compute, storage, networking and databases into systems that are secure, resilient and cost-efficient.

r_dva.reason: Made for people who write code that runs on AWS: serverless functions, APIs, databases and deployment pipelines. DevOps Engineer – Professional is where this path leads.

r_cloudops.reason: Focused on running workloads well: monitoring, troubleshooting, automation and reliability. It used to be called SysOps Administrator, and it leads naturally to DevOps Engineer – Professional.

r_dea.reason: You'll learn to build data pipelines and data stores on AWS. Good data foundations are what AI and ML run on, so ML Engineer – Associate is a strong next step.

r_security_start.reason: Security – Specialty expects real experience, so start with Solutions Architect – Associate. It builds the base that cloud security sits on: identity and access, networking and encryption.

r_mla.reason: It covers the full ML workflow on AWS: preparing data, training, deploying and maintaining models. Generative AI Developer – Professional is the advanced step if you move toward LLM products.

r_genai_start.reason: Generative AI Developer – Professional is the cert for building LLM apps, but it is a professional-level exam. AI Practitioner is a quick first win that covers generative AI concepts and the AWS services behind them. If you already build on AWS every day, you can aim for the professional exam directly.

r_aif_explore.reason: The best way to get the big picture of AI, ML and generative AI before choosing a direction. Afterwards, ML Engineer – Associate takes you hands-on.

r_sap.reason: Built for designing complex AWS solutions across many accounts, including migrations and hybrid setups. It's one of the most respected AWS certifications.

r_dop.reason: Validates CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and automation for distributed systems at scale. Security – Specialty pairs well with it.

r_aip.reason: The newest professional certification, built for engineers shipping generative AI products on AWS with services like Amazon Bedrock.

r_ml_next.reason: The Machine Learning – Specialty exam was retired in March 2026, so ML Engineer – Associate is now AWS's main ML certification. Generative AI Developer – Professional is the advanced step after it.

r_scs.reason: The dedicated AWS security certification: identity and access, data protection, detection and incident response.

r_networking.reason: The Advanced Networking – Specialty exam is being retired at the end of 2026. Solutions Architect – Professional is the strongest current option and covers network connectivity design for large and hybrid setups.

clf.name: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
clf.summary: Shows you understand the AWS Cloud as a whole: core services, pricing and billing, security basics and global infrastructure. Not tied to any job role.

aif.name: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
aif.summary: Covers the foundations of AI, machine learning and generative AI, their use cases, and the AWS services that support them.
aif.good_for: Anyone who wants to understand AI on AWS before going deeper.

aib.name: AWS Certified AI Business Strategist
aib.summary: Tests business judgment for AI: which AI investments to pursue, how to build the business case, governance and responsible AI, and scaling adoption. No coding, and it does not test AWS services.
aib.note: Currently offered as a beta exam.

saa.name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
saa.summary: Designing secure, resilient, high-performing and cost-efficient systems on AWS, based on the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
saa.good_for: The classic first technical cert; AWS recommends it for people moving into cloud careers.

dva.name: AWS Certified Developer – Associate
dva.summary: Developing, deploying and debugging cloud-based applications on AWS.
dva.good_for: Developers who write code that runs on AWS.
dva.note: A new exam version that adds AI-assisted development tools starts on 1 Dec 2026; the current version can be taken until 30 Nov 2026.

cloudops.name: AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate
cloudops.summary: Deploying, managing and operating workloads on AWS: monitoring, troubleshooting, automation, security controls and networking. Formerly called SysOps Administrator – Associate.
cloudops.good_for: People who like keeping systems healthy and running.

dea.name: AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate
dea.summary: Building data pipelines and data stores on AWS and optimizing their cost and performance.
dea.good_for: Data-minded students heading toward data or AI engineering.

mla.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate
mla.summary: Implementing, deploying and maintaining AI and ML solutions on AWS.
mla.good_for: People who want to build and run ML models, not just use them.
mla.note: The exam was updated to a new version in 2026; use the latest exam guide when studying.

sap.name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
sap.summary: Designing complex, optimized AWS solutions based on the Well-Architected Framework. Intended for people with 2+ years of hands-on experience.
sap.good_for: Experienced architects working across many accounts and services.
sap.note: The exam is being updated: the current version can be taken until 16 Nov 2026, then the new version replaces it.

dop.name: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
dop.summary: Provisioning, operating and managing distributed application systems on AWS, including CI/CD, automation and infrastructure as code. Intended for people with 2+ years of experience.
dop.good_for: Developers and operations engineers who automate everything.

aip.name: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional
aip.summary: Designing, building and deploying production generative AI solutions on AWS, using services like Amazon Bedrock.
aip.note: AWS suggests AI Practitioner, Solutions Architect – Associate, ML Engineer – Associate and/or Data Engineer – Associate as helpful preparation.

scs.name: AWS Certified Security – Specialty
scs.summary: Securing AWS workloads and applications: identity and access, data protection, detection and incident response.
